command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/relative-symlink-relocation
bundle=$base/bundle
before=$(find "$bundle" -type f -exec sha256sum {} + | sort)
printf '%s\n' "$before"
awk 'NR > 1 {print $1, $2}' "$base/links.tsv" | while read -r link target; do
  [ -n "$link" ] && [ -n "$target" ]
  [ -L "$bundle/$link" ]
  case "$link:$target" in /*:*|*:/*|*..*) exit 20;; esac
  [ -e "$bundle/$target" ]
  tmp="$bundle/.${link}.new.$$"
  ln -s "$target" "$tmp"
  mv -Tf "$tmp" "$bundle/$link"
done
after=$(find "$bundle" -type f -exec sha256sum {} + | sort)
[ "$before" = "$after" ]
printf '%s\n' 'symlinks repaired; regular-file hashes unchanged'
find "$bundle" -maxdepth 1 -type l -printf '%f -> %l\n' | sort

command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/relative-symlink-relocation
bundle=$base/bundle
testdir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/relative-link-test.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$testdir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
cp -a "$bundle" "$testdir/relocated"
printf '%s\n' 'manifest verification (original and relocated copy):'
awk 'NR > 1 {print $1, $2}' "$base/links.tsv" | while read -r link target; do
  for root in "$bundle" "$testdir/relocated"; do
    [ -L "$root/$link" ]
    actual=$(readlink "$root/$link")
    [ "$actual" = "$target" ]
    [ "${actual#/}" = "$actual" ]
    [ -e "$root/$link" ]
  done
  orig_hash=$(sha256sum "$bundle/$link" | awk '{print $1}')
  copy_hash=$(sha256sum "$testdir/relocated/$link" | awk '{print $1}')
  [ "$orig_hash" = "$copy_hash" ]
  printf '%s -> %s | resolves after copy | sha256=%s\n' "$link" "$target" "$orig_hash"
done
printf '%s\n' 'regular files:'
find "$bundle" -type f -exec sha256sum {} + | sort
printf '%s\n' 'relocation test: PASS'
